title: JWT Authentication
description: Build a JWT-based authentication system with login, protected routes, and token validation.

steps.title: Login endpoint
steps.description: Create a POST /auth/login endpoint that accepts username and password in the body, validates them, and returns a JWT token signed with HS256.
hints: Use express.json() to parse request body
Include 'sub', 'iat', and 'exp' claims in the payload

steps.title: Get current user with valid token
steps.description: Create a GET /me endpoint that returns user information when a valid JWT token is provided in the Authorization header as Bearer token.
hints: Split the token, verify the signature using HMAC-SHA256
Decode the payload and return user info: { userId, username }
Reuse the SECRET and HMAC function from step 1

steps.title: Protected route without token
steps.description: Ensure that GET /me returns 401 when no token or an invalid token is provided in the Authorization header.
hints: Check that the Authorization header is missing or doesn't start with 'Bearer '
If token is provided but invalid, return 401 with { error: 'Invalid token' }

steps.title: Token expiry validation
steps.description: Implement token expiry checking. Return 401 if the token is expired or has an invalid signature. Test with an expired token and a tampered token.
hints: Check the 'exp' claim against the current time
If expired, return 401 with { error: 'Token expired' }
Also verify the HMAC signature — tampered tokens should be rejected
